How to make sourdough bread at home

Sourdough bread needs only flour, water, and salt, plus a lively starter. Feed your starter the night before so it is bubbly and doubled in size by morning.

Mix 500 grams of bread flour with 350 grams of water and let it rest for an hour. This rest, called the autolyse, makes the dough easier to shape later on.

Add 100 grams of starter and 10 grams of salt, then fold the dough every thirty minutes for two hours. Let it rise until it grows by about half, shape it into a round loaf, and proof it overnight in the fridge.

Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at 250 degrees Celsius for twenty minutes with the lid on, then another twenty five minutes with the lid off until the crust is deep brown.
